description:
Japan imported rifles from pirate and reproduced it to attack the Ming empire. First, Japan made the Josun empire as a logistics base and caused a war 'Imjinwaeran' to make Josun's nation as spread head. When Josun empire's capital, 'Hanyang and Pyeongyang' took over by Japan, the Ming empire joined the war. Japan built a fortress on the Southside of Josun and dragged time to make an association with Ming. Meanwhile, the intense war was going on in the trade business as well. After the fail of association, Japan started to drag Josun into hell of plunder and slaughter...   
(From KENAZ's website)
